name: Quantum Metric
description: Analyze funnels, errors, friction and session replays in Quantum Metric to find and fix digital experience issues.
notes: Quantum Metric's official hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Quantum Metric account; every call runs with that user's role and permissions.
installHint: Quantum Metric's hosted MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; no client credentials are needed. Sign in with your Quantum Metric account and choose your subscription when prompted. It works with a subscription that already collects data.
